gateways.name: Nagano Station
gateways.notes: Hokuriku Shinkansen terminus and the primary gateway to Hakuba. Alpico Express buses depart from East Exit bus stop #6 (~1h to Hakuba).

gateways.name: Matsumoto Station
gateways.notes: Alternative southern gateway via the JR Oito Line direct to Hakuba Station (~90 min). Useful when combining with the Japan Alps or Kamikochi.

gateways.name: Hakuba Station
gateways.notes: JR Oito Line station serving Hakuba village. Walking distance to Happo Bus Terminal; taxi rank outside. Limited service in winter.

gateways.name: Happo Bus Terminal
gateways.name_ja: 白馬八方バスターミナル
gateways.notes: Hakuba Valley's transport hub. Alpico Express, Hakuba Valley Shuttle, and resort shuttles all converge here.

gateways.name: Tokyo Haneda Airport
gateways.notes: Closest international airport to Tokyo Station for the Hokuriku Shinkansen transfer. Allow ~30 min Haneda → Tokyo Station via Keikyu + JR.

gateways.name: Narita International Airport
gateways.notes: Most long-haul carriers. ~1 h to Tokyo Station via Narita Express, then 100 min Hokuriku Shinkansen to Nagano.

routes.notes: Hokuriku Shinkansen. Kagayaki is fastest (no Karuizawa stop).
Departs Nagano Station East Exit, stop #6. A few daily services are reservation-only in winter; book at visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp.
Direct highway-bus alternative to the shinkansen route. The overnight service arrives in time for first lifts; cheapest option from Tokyo.
Scenic single-track line through the Northern Alps. Slower than the shinkansen + bus route but works well when arriving via Chubu Centrair (NGO).
Seasonal direct Narita → Hakuba coach. Convenient with ski bags; book ahead via naganosnowshuttle.com.

in_resort_transport.name: Hakuba Valley Shuttle
in_resort_transport.notes: Free inter-resort shuttle linking Happo-One, Iwatake, Goryu, Hakuba 47, Tsugaike, Cortina and Norikura with a valid Hakuba Valley lift ticket.

in_resort_transport.name: Happo Village Loop Shuttle
in_resort_transport.notes: Free village loop connecting Happo Bus Terminal to Wadano, Sakka, Nakiyama and Echoland lift bases. Runs during winter season only.
